steps.name: Fill closure
steps.do: Pick **Canadian Domain** (map closed overlay exists only for **Canadian Domain**, **Kids Zoo**, and **Americas Outdoor Mayan Temple Ruins**). Set a date range covering today, and enter a **Closure message** (e.g. **Manual test exhibit closed**).

steps.name: Submit closed
steps.expect: Success “Canadian Domain was set as closed.”

steps.name: Map overlay
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today.
steps.expect: Gray closed-exhibit overlay appears over **Canadian Domain**.

steps.name: Itinerary impact
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Build/edit for today. In the animal picker, leave **Include off-display animals** unchecked and search for a **Canadian Domain** animal (e.g. **Wood Bison**). Then enable **Include off-display animals** and try adding that animal.
steps.expect: With include off, the animal does not appear in results. With include on, it appears; adding it shows **Animal May Be Off Display**.

steps.name: Re-open exhibit
steps.do: In Console, open **Set exhibit as open**. Re-open **Canadian Domain** for a date range covering today and submit.

steps.name: Overlay gone
steps.do: From the bottom nav, return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today.

steps.name: Itinerary normal
steps.do: Return to **Itinerary** for today. With **Include off-display animals** unchecked, search for **Wood Bison** (or another **Canadian Domain** animal) and add it.
steps.expect: Animal appears in results without needing include-off-display; adding does not show **Animal May Be Off Display**.
